messages:
luca: Heads-up: eu-north-1 warm-pool onboarding failures started ~09:10 UTC after TGW route and firewall tighten landed. Keystore decrypts failing.
hana: I saw the same alert. Which change landed?
luca: TGW route table update RT-2026-337 added a more restrictive next-hop that accidentally sent keystore traffic to a transit VPC without NAT. FW deny then dropped it.
dev-bot: route-deploy: RT-2026-337 applied to eu-north-1 at 2026-03-26T09:05Z.
arjun: Logs: ```
keystore-proxy ERR: dial tcp 10.200.14.8:443 -> remote 192.0.2.5:443: connection reset
agent: join state=ProvisioningPending reason="kms handshake timeout" attempts=4
```
hana: Role-boundary prevents me from editing TGW routes; only net-admins can. We need a rapid fallback.
luca: Temporary mitigation: created a route override in the warm-pool route-table back to nat-main-eunorth with TTL 40m: `infractl route override add --rtb warm-pool-eunorth --dest 13.35.0.0/16 --target nat-main-eunorth --ttl 40m`. Nodes recovered within 5m.
dev-bot: monitor: warm-pool-eunorth healthy_nodes: 8 -> 47 (5m).
arjun: Cost impact: churn + extra spinups ~7 GPU-hours ~USD 1.9k. Add to post-incident cost.
hana: Proposals: (1) TGW/prefix changes must include a simulated warm-pool e2e step that verifies KMS decrypt; (2) deny rules that could block private endpoint flows should be gated and ordered allow-before-deny; (3) a scoped operator role to create route overrides with audit logs.
compliance-bot: exception recorded id=EXC-EU-2026-332 by luca; linked change=RT-2026-337; expires=2026-03-26T10:00Z. Audit attached.
luca: Filing incident RED-IF-9922 "TGW route misroute + FW deny => keystore decrypt failures -> warm-pool onboarding churn". Assigning eng-platform + eng-infra.
arjun: Short-term follow-ups: rollback RT-2026-337, add preflight decrypt probe to route PRs, and add runbook for rapid route override without full net-admin role.
hana: Thanks. Will update when PR with gating is ready. Closing when postmortem and cost reconciliation posted.
